purpose: Teach: 文藝春秋/自営業/発刊/主将/関心事/講堂/ブレーク/学識

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文藝春秋から論評の依頼が来た
lines.en: Ren — Bungei Shunju has requested a critical review from us.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Leans back slightly. Matter-of-fact tone without pressure. The ease of a senior who's passing on opportunity, not burden.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の先輩は自営業の研究室を始められました
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, alert posture. Genuine interest underneath the formality. Eyes brighten slightly — this is something he takes seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文集の発刊計画を立てろ
lines.en: Ren — put together a publication plan for the collected papers.
lines.style: Direct instruction, no softening. Sits forward slightly. Conviction on the key word 「計画を立てろ」. Not asking — confident Ren can do this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の主将的なリーダーから推薦を頂きました
lines.en: Yes. I received a recommendation from one of the conference leaders.
lines.style: Careful, precise wording. Slight pause before the second clause — measuring his words. Respectful without obsequiousness. Quiet pride underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学界の関心事を論文で取り上げろ
lines.en: Ren — make sure the papers address what the academic world is actually thinking about right now.
lines.style: Lean emphasis on 「関心事を」. Steady, no performance. The instruction of someone who knows the field. Expects Ren to understand the weight of relevance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。大学の講堂で公開講座を行います
lines.en: Yes. We'll be holding an open lecture at the university hall.
lines.style: Nod on the opening 「はい」. Calm, methodical delivery. Speaking from preparation, not hesitation. The confidence of someone who's already thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究でブレークスルーを目指せ
lines.en: Ren — aim for a real breakthrough in your research.
lines.style: Slight increase in intensity. Direct eye contact. The word 「ブレークスルー」lands with quiet weight. Not a suggestion — a challenge wrapped in trust.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者の学識を学会で活かします
lines.en: Yes. I'll bring what I learn to the conference.
lines.style: Final response — grounded, closing note. Steady breath. No trailing hesitation. The closing statement of someone who understands they've been given direction and will follow through.
